::: {.unit unit="lp-breacher"}
It throws demolition charges that wreck walls and turrets and do little to units.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-trooper"}
Cheap, quick to train and quick to lose. Troopers win against raiders and lose against lasers.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-rocket-trooper"}
It kills armor and fliers, and is slow against a crowd.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-battle-tank"}
The answer to a walled camp. It takes the longest to train and the most bandwidth.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-flame-trooper"}
It burns swarms of biters and bunched infantry, and is outranged by nearly everything.
:::
